text:
Alex (Marketing): Dropping the near-final blog draft + two hero CTA variants (A: "Watch the launch webinar" B: "See Redwood in action"). Also mocked a micro-modal sign-up. Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/blog-draft-v5

Priya (Growth): Nice. Suggest we A/B test CTAs and modal vs full page form. Run for 1 week, look at CTR -> conversion. Can we capture utm_content=webinar_modal vs webinar_page?

Mira (Product): Agreed on A/B. Also can we simplify the benchmark line to: "~20ms median latency on typical L2 workloads (internal benchmark)" and add a parenthetical about quantization impact. No raw numbers like 10-30ms.

Jules (SEO): For SEO, include "low-latency inference" in H1 and keep meta title under 60 chars. Prefer canonical /products/dedicated-inference-launch. I'll post exact meta copy in the doc.

Ken (Design): Modal mock ready in Figma. Micro-form request: name + work email + checkbox for webinar reminders. Suggest primary button "Save my spot". I can export assets after copy finalization. :art:

Alex (Marketing): Proposed UTMs: `?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch_post&utm_campaign=dedicated_launch&utm_content={variant}` where variant = webinar_modal | webinar_page | demo_cta. Ops: ok to standardize?

Ops (Growth Ops): That UTM scheme works. We'll map `utm_content` into HubSpot hidden field `orig_content` and then trigger `workflow: webinar-nurture`. Make sure `utm_term` is used by paid channels.

Legal Bot: Remove superlatives. Change "best-in-class" -> "production-grade". Also we need BI-2025-004 attached if we say "internal benchmark". Please link sheet.

Mira (Product): I'll attach BI-2025-004 and a 1-sentence note: "Quantization may reduce latency further with modest quality tradeoffs. See appendix."

Priya (Growth): Email reminders: 24h and 1h pre-webinar plus a thank-you sequence post-event. I'll draft subject lines once final headline locks. Also request we add webinarEvent JSON-LD to page for rich results.

Jules (SEO): I'll add JSON-LD snippet (article + webinarEvent). Also set og:title to match H1 and include image.

Ken (Design): For A variant use smaller hero image to keep fold shallow — mobile first. For B use expanded hero with product snapshot. I'll add both to Figma.

Alex (Marketing): Timeline: finalize copy + legal check today, design assets + JSON-LD tomorrow, schedule CMS publish for Wed 9am PT. Ops, can you queue social and newsletter snippets?

Ops (Growth Ops): Yep. I'll prepare social cards and the HubSpot campaign and confirm workflows. Need final publish URL to set tracking.

Legal Bot: Approved with edits. No competitive claims without citation.

Mira (Product): Quick QA: add one-line note above benchmark table: "Dedicated capacity is optimized for predictable throughput and lower tail latency." Keeps it non-comparative.

Priya (Growth): For the A/B test, we'll route 50/50 and track: click_rate, modal_conversion, webinar_reg_rate, and demo_clicks. I'll put the experiment spec in the doc.

Alex (Marketing): All good. I'll swap superlatives and update UTMs + link BI sheet. If everyone OK, schedule Wed 9am PT. React with :thumbsup: to approve.

Ken (Design): :thumbsup:

Jules (SEO): :thumbsup:

Priya (Growth): :thumbsup:

Mira (Product): :thumbsup:

Ops (Growth Ops): :thumbsup:

Legal Bot: Approved.
